ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $D$ is a point on side $BC$, and $AB=AD=DC$. If $\angle B=60^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=AD$, and $\angle B=60^\circ$,\\
thus, $\triangle ABD$ is an equilateral triangle,\\
therefore, $\angle ADB=60^\circ$,\\
Since $AD=CD$,\\
thus $\angle C=\angle DAC=\frac{1}{2}\angle ADB= \boxed{30^\circ}$
